limits: Every assigned complete saved text was read in numbered batches; template fingerprints were not used to infer unexamined classifications.
Public ledger omits auction amounts, yields, yield-condition ranges and calculated financial features. Calendar dates, security tenors and stated closing clocks are documentary metadata.

A notice classification is separate from final result identity/lineage reconciliation, source admission, and historical first-version recovery. No source allocation correction, test or first allocation addendum was found among these83 notices; that does not generalize to other assigned notices.

All archive memberships are preserved. Body scopes also retain bill, FRN, general-schedule, announcement, payment and conditional alternative-security references outside those memberships. Metadata-mapped CUSIPs are explicitly distinguished from CUSIPs printed in the body.
Dated headers establish source-document release-date evidence, not actual historical delivery timestamps or contemporaneous hashes. Conditional outcomes were not computed from numerical yields.

Four complete originals were rendered at110dpi and visually read to resolve or preserve ambiguity; their image hashes and render logs are retained privately. The first render emitted font-cache warnings but produced a complete readable page; subsequent renders used a private writable font cache.
The only additional notice text read was the parent's identified January26,2015 rescheduling cross-reference, with original/text pins verified and both schedule stages retained.
No network requests, new source captures, market arrays, model cohorts, fits, scores, prior-file edits or additional agents.
